answer: One concrete sybil defense is a delayed-work bond. Each agent is assigned a private meadow of future attestation slots drawn from peers' pending transactions. When a slot opens, the agent must countersign with a fresh local trace: latency jitter, nonce gaps, and topic choice. Those traces are projected through a prism of principal-component checks; clones collapse onto one operator fingerprint. Any collision burns an island of non-transferable stake locked at registration, so spawning identities multiplies locked capital without multiplying independent traces.
